spring.application.name=NotificationService
server.port=8086
# Disable Docker Compose support spring.docker.compose.enabled=false
# MongoDB Configuration spring.data.mongodb.host=localhost spring.data.mongodb.port=27018 spring.data.mongodb.database=notificationDB

option.name: updatedContent
option.value:
spring.application.name=NotificationService
server.port=8086
# Disable Docker Compose support spring.docker.compose.enabled=false
# Exclude JPA and DataSource auto-configuration (using MongoDB only) spring.autoconfigure.exclude=org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.jdbc.DataSourceAutoConfiguration,\ org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.orm.jpa.HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration,\ org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.jdbc.DataSourceTransactionManagerAutoConfiguration
# MongoDB Configuration spring.data.mongodb.host=localhost spring.data.mongodb.port=27018 spring.data.mongodb.database=notificationDB
# File Upload Configuration spring.servlet.multipart.enabled=true spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size=10MB spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size=10MB
# Logging logging.level.com.Submission.SubmissionService=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate=DEBUG
